iconicAnchor.label: The Art Nouveau whiplash line
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: The elastic asymmetrical curve explains how Art Nouveau binds stems, hair, bodies, lettering, furniture, and architecture into an integrated organic composition.

sources.title: The whiplash
supports: The whiplash is a dynamic, sinuous line whose changing tension organizes both structural and decorative Art Nouveau forms.

sources.title: Art Nouveau: an international style
supports: Art Nouveau crossed media and national variants while pursuing integrated design, stylized natural forms, and a break from copied historical ornament.
